methodology: Composition picks are supported by Season 11 creator coverage and community guides. The equipment below combines current source loadouts for each role; it is not a claimed copy of the video’s exact gear. Composition choices require review after balance changes.

teams.name: Double Heavy + healer
teams.description: Two Heavies hold space while the Medium heals and revives. Alternate Dome Shields and avoid leaving the healer exposed.
teams.tradeoff: Less mobility. Wide flanks and isolated fights can pull the team apart.

players.task: Hold the contested angle with Mesh Shield. Make space for the Medium to heal and revive.
Control the cashout approach with Winch Claw. Commit when your anchor and healer are in range.
Stay a step behind the Heavies. Preserve Defibrillator for a recoverable revive and use Jump Pad for team rotations.

evidence.title: HHM Is The New META Ranked Comp In S11
evidence.creator: commit
evidence.note: Also supported by the community’s patch 11.7 specialization and gadget guides.

teams.name: Heavy + Medium + Light
teams.description: Heavy takes the objective fight, Medium provides healing and revives, and Light supplies Gateway and disruption.
teams.tradeoff: The Light is vulnerable alone. Gateway positioning and synchronized engagements matter more than chasing eliminations.

players.task: Take the close objective fight after the Light creates an opening. Cover the Medium with Dome Shield.
Support the Heavy, keep a safe revive lane, and call when the team needs to reset.
Prepare Gateway for entry or escape. Use Glitch Grenade to disrupt the hold and H+ Infuser for timely support.
